summary: Backend CSV export fix (Turkish Excel semicolon delimiter + BOM + sep=; hint) verified. All 15 pytest checks passed including raw-byte validation of BOM (EF BB BF), 'sep=;\r\n' hint, semicolon header, CRLF line endings, RFC-5987 UTF-8 filename*, semicolon-in-field quoting, bulk-import round-trip, order create/cancel stock restoration, bulk replace, and 6 seeded customers. Prior UnicodeEncodeError on Content-Disposition also resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~614 lines - approaching split threshold; consider modularizing (routes/customers, routes/orders, routes/exports).
csv_response builds full CSV in memory via StringIO before StreamingResponse - fine for current sizes (2k products / 10k movements) but not truly streaming; document limits.
export_movements limits to 10000; large customers could silently truncate. Consider pagination or streaming cursor.
seed_data_creation: Test creates transient TEST_ products/packages and cleans up. Uses first seeded customer (Müşteri A).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_csv_export.py has 4 classes: TestAuth, TestCsvFormat (BOM/sep=/CRLF/quoted semicolons/UTF-8 filename*), TestBulkImportRoundtrip, TestRegression (product CRUD, order/cancel restores stock + 'cancel' movement, bulk replace mode, 6 customers). Runs in ~4s. To run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_csv_export.py -v -o addopts=''. The pytest.ini in /app/backend uses xdist which conflicted with global pytest; used -o addopts='' to bypass.
